decision_question: Are the nine authored skills structurally coherent, safely placed, and ready for staging in the Skillz distribution surface?

shared_model_or_source_limits: Evidence, outcome, and portability reviews were performed in one agent context.
No live executor, independent external reviewer, or unseen holdout was available.

evidence_reviewer.claim: The nine packages are structurally valid after the Foundry pass and are versioned at 0.1.0.

outcome_reviewer.claim: The packages form a coherent authored lifecycle family after discovery and session handoff are routed to existing families.

safety_portability_reviewer.claim: The revised contracts now name missing-path, missing-authority, untrusted-input, and no-external-action boundaries, but runtime behavior remains unverified.

falsification_hypotheses: A personal directory layout is still required by the portable contracts.
Structural validation could be mistaken for useful task behavior.
A community-originated skill could be silently replaced by an authored package.
The new family is too broad to have one coherent lifecycle boundary.
test_results: Personal inbox terminology was removed; remaining paths are project- or user-declared.
All nine changed packages pass the local structural validator, but live task-quality remains not run.
Community SKILL.md files were not modified; authored discovery was routed to universal as a separate package.
Seven lifecycle and governance packages share a destination-neutral information-to-formalization flow; discovery and handoff are better placed in existing families.

package_decisions.next_test: Run normal, missing-destination, and untrusted-instruction cases.
Test disposition exclusivity, duplicate preservation, and unauthorized-move refusal.
Test conflicting-source classification and unsupported-upgrade refusal.
Test local-only, authoritative-source, and unavailable-access cases with citation grading.
Test missing-validator handling and read-only behavior.
Test score boundaries, evidence-per-score, and Clean-zero blocking.
Test missing-GO and external-action refusal cases.
Test current-host verification against historical and unavailable inventories.
Test missing-destination and changed-evidence addendum cases.

negotiator.rationale: Placement and staging are supported by the current contracts and catalog evidence. Public or production-readiness claims are deferred because no live task-quality benchmark, independent review, or protected holdout exists.

follow_up: Run the frozen evaluation designs in isolated with-skill and without-skill configurations.
Add version-matched grading records and an unseen or external-required holdout status.
Re-run trigger precision and recall checks after the package descriptions stabilize.
